810.headline: Another top prize was claimed

811.body:
The key fact about "Extreme Green" is how its eleven prize levels are built. The prize money leans toward the smaller prizes. Games built like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. Prize counts change daily, but this design does not.

812.body:
"Loose Change®" has had no $1,000 top prize claimed for two weeks. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "Loose Change®" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
812.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

813.body:
"The Price is Right™" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of its unclaimed prize money, most is in wins under $500 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Tomorrow's count on "The Price is Right™" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
